budget_note: Budget is charged per segment polled, even if a segment has zero fixtures, because polling a segment is an attempt regardless of results. With pagination, a segment costs one call per page, with a minimum of one call per segment polled. This ledger is a fixture simulation, not production-grade cost enforcement.

qualifying_definition: A qualifying match here means only: in radius, and inside the segment's price/year bounds, plus its model/make bounds when the segment is a category segment. It is NOT a deal, a valuation, or a profit estimate. Per-segment match totals must not be summed: use global_matches for unique qualifying vehicles.
relist_definition: Genuine relist: same dedupe key, same segment, later first_seen_at than the first observation in that segment, and a different source_id. The first observation is the canonical first: records are sorted before deduplication by known first_seen_at first, earliest first_seen_at, source_id, posted_at, then a deterministic tie-breaker over title, price, year, make, model, odometer, ZIP, and photo hash; fixture input order never decides it. Repeated observation: same dedupe key, same segment, but not a genuine relist (same or earlier first_seen_at, or the same source_id). Cross-segment overlap is neither a relist nor a repeated observation. Global freshness uses one canonical observation per vehicle (earliest known first_seen_at, tie-broken by source_id then posted_at) and only that observation's own first_seen_at and posted_at pair; dates are never combined across observations.
scope: Separate preliminary fixture measurement only. NOT the PILOT_TUSCALOOSA.md pilot (150 miles, 10 testers). Fixture counts are NOT observed market inventory, customer demand, valuation accuracy, or licensing permission.
